release_notes: The HikMicro HM-TD1228T-2 is a bi-spectrum thermography turret built for substations, hydropower and waste-incineration plants, pairing a 256x192 thermal module with a 5 MP optical channel and high-range temperature measurement (-20 to 650 C, +/-2 C or +/-2%). It adds fire and smoke detection plus sun-reflection and forklift-alarm filtering.

home_assistant.notes: Hikvision-platform ONVIF (default port 80, Profile S/G). Thermal + optical exposed as separate channels.
